event.distribution_pattern: Nationwide including government commissaries. No foreign consignees.

products.product_description: Organic Horizon Sandwich Crackers Cheddar, 7.5 oz packages, 12 boxes per case.
products.code_info: Best Before date: 17 MAY 2015 on top of individual box. UPC: 42365 00464 on bottom of box. Wholesale customers should look for cases with UPC: 42365 00465 for Peanut Butter sandwich crackers, same Best Before date.
products.reason_for_recall: WhiteWave Foods is voluntarily recalling 7.5 oz packages of Horizon Cheddar Sandwich Crackers because they may contain undeclared peanuts due to an inadvertent packaging error. The outer package is labeled as a cheddar sandwich cracker and the inner package contains the peanut butter sandwich crackers.
